compiled_state.title: Add Step 2 Remediation Re-dispatch block (approach-proposer) with paired RED fixture
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When Step 2 architectural reviewers return failure, the orchestrator's next dispatch targets dso:approach-proposer with the literal `model: "opus"` field on the dispatch payload and remediation_context containing absolute artifact paths

## Scope

Add a self-contained 'Remediation Re-dispatch' subsection to Step 2 of plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md, placed immediately after the existing reviewer dispatch description and before the existing fallback paragraph. The subsection MUST:

1. State the trigger: on Step 2 architectural-reviewer FAIL verdict.
2. Re-dispatch dso:approach-proposer with `model: "opus"` on the dispatch payload (literal string).
3. Build a remediation_context block containing absolute artifact file paths (reviewer-findings paths, original approach proposal path).
4. Pass artifacts by reference (absolute file paths), not by inlining content.
5. Declare the mode (e.g., `mode: remediation`) on the dispatch.
6. Reference evidence quotes from reviewer findings (anchor text the fixture can grep for).
7. End with a single-line ticket-comment instruction per SC5 single-comment policy.

Then create tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step2-remediation.sh following the awk-scoped-section pattern from test-approach-proposer-remediation.sh (d071). The fixture must FAIL before the SKILL.md edit and PASS after.

The fixture asserts: (a) 'Remediation Re-dispatch' subsection heading in Step 2, (b) literal model: "opus", (c) remediation_context keyword with absolute paths, (d) mode: remediation, (e) evidence-quotes anchor, (f) dso:approach-proposer as re-dispatch target. Make fixture executable (chmod +x).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria

- Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- Fixture script exists and is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step2-remediation.sh
- Fixture script passes against the updated SKILL.md (exit 0) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step2-remediation.sh
- SKILL.md Step 2 section contains a 'Remediation Re-dispatch' subsection heading — Verify: awk '/^## Step 2/,/^## Step 3/' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md | grep -q 'Remediation Re-dispatch'
- Step 2 subsection contains literal model: "opus" — Verify: awk '/^## Step 2/,/^## Step 3/' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md | grep -q 'model: "opus"'
- Step 2 subsection references dso:approach-proposer as re-dispatch target — Verify: awk '/^## Step 2/,/^## Step 3/' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md | grep -q 'dso:approach-proposer'
- Step 2 subsection passes artifacts by reference (absolute path) — Verify: awk '/^## Step 2/,/^## Step 3/' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md | grep -qE 'absolute (file )?path|by reference'
- Step 2 subsection declares mode: remediation — Verify: awk '/^## Step 2/,/^## Step 3/' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md | grep -qE 'mode:[[:space:]]*remediation'
- Step 2 subsection ends with SC5 single-comment instruction — Verify: awk '/^## Step 2/,/^## Step 3/' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md | grep -qE 'ticket comment|SC5'
